title: Build: move src/common C++ projects from packages.config to PackageReference (CPP-2, slice 1)

proposed_comments.body:
### Match the existing project XML spacing

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking formatting suggestion: these three self-closing package elements omit the space before `/>` used by the surrounding project elements. Aligning that whitespace keeps this migration diff consistent; it does not change MSBuild properties, package selection, restore behavior, or build results.

```suggestion
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK" GeneratePathProperty="true" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK.Foundation" GeneratePathProperty="true" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Windows.CppWinRT" GeneratePathProperty="true" />
```
proposed_comments.title: Match the existing project XML spacing

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.
